Obsidian Second Brain Setup — YouTube Research
Research compiled on 2026-03-11 from 6 YouTube searches across English and Russian content.

1. Obsidian Publish Free Alternatives








































#TitleChannelViewsURL1Give Me 15 Minutes. I’ll Teach You 80% of ObsidianLinking Your Thinking (Nick Milo)637Kwatch2How the CEO of Obsidian Takes his Notes (Underrated Genius)Karlos Obsidian Tutorials204Kwatch3This Obsidian update will make you STOP SCROLLING (Mobile 2.0)Linking Your Thinking56Kwatch4Offline Alternatives For Obsidian (2026)Emma’s Productivity Lab128watch
Takeaways: The search didn’t surface many dedicated “free publish alternatives” videos. Most results focus on general Obsidian setup. Quartz, Digital Garden plugin, and MkDocs are the commonly mentioned free alternatives to Obsidian Publish in descriptions. Kepano’s (Steph Ango, CEO) vault walkthrough is highly recommended for understanding Obsidian philosophy.

2. Obsidian Second Brain Best Setup















































#TitleChannelViewsURL1Give Me 15 Minutes. I’ll Teach You 80% of ObsidianLinking Your Thinking (Nick Milo)637Kwatch2How the CEO of Obsidian Takes his NotesKarlos Obsidian Tutorials204Kwatch3Why I switched to using Obsidian (as a former Notion user)Reysu157Kwatch4How I Use Obsidian + Claude Code to Run My LifeGreg Isenberg149Kwatch5AI Second Brain with Claude Code and Obsidian [Project Cornelius]Eugene Vyborov86Kwatch
Takeaways: Nick Milo’s “80% of Obsidian in 15 min” is the dominant entry point (637K views). The Obsidian + Claude Code combination is a major trend in 2026 — both Greg Isenberg and Eugene Vyborov showcase deep AI-driven workflows. Project Cornelius (github.com/AbilityJLR) is an open-source framework for swapping “brains” in Obsidian with AI agents. Notion-to-Obsidian migration is a common theme. Ideaverse (Nick Milo’s starter kit) is frequently referenced as a recommended starting point.

3. Obsidian AI Integration (Claude)





















































#TitleChannelViewsDateURL1How I Use Obsidian + Claude Code to Run My LifeGreg Isenberg149KFeb 23watch2Claude Code + Obsidian = UNSTOPPABLEChase AI55KMar 4watch3Claude Code + NotebookLM + Obsidian = GOD MODEChase AI30KMar 5watch4I connected Claude Code to Obsidian and it made me 10x more productiveNoah Vincent13KFeb 27watch5How I Run AI Agents From My Obsidian Notes with ClaudeThe Augmented590Feb 28watch
Takeaways: This is the hottest topic in the Obsidian ecosystem right now (Feb-Mar 2026). Key patterns:

Claude Code as Obsidian co-pilot — agents read/write vault files, execute tasks from notes
NotebookLM + Obsidian — feeding vault content into NotebookLM for audio summaries and research
Agent dispatch from notes — structuring tasks in Obsidian, then dispatching parallel AI agents
Greg Isenberg’s video (149K, 59 min) is the most comprehensive walkthrough of the Obsidian+Claude workflow
Chase AI’s channel is pumping out Obsidian+AI content rapidly


4. Must-Have Obsidian Plugins (2025-2026)















































#TitleChannelViewsURL1The Only 6 Obsidian Plugins You Actually Need in 2026Focus Cafe57Kwatch2Top 5 NEW Obsidian Themes in 2025Karlos Obsidian Tutorials27Kwatch3This One Obsidian Plugin Changes EverythingFocus Cafe21Kwatch47 Best Obsidian Tips & Tricks In 2025Be Productive8Kwatch55 Plugins That Instantly Upgrade ObsidianFocus Cafe5Kwatch
Takeaways:

Notebook Navigator — highlighted as a single plugin that replaces 5 others (Focus Cafe, 21K views)
Bases (core plugin) — new dynamic databases plugin, built-in alternative to Dataview
Semantic Linking — emerging as a key feature for AI-ready vaults
Graph View analytics — using graph as an analytical tool, not just visualization
Focus Cafe is the go-to channel for plugin recommendations (3 of top 5 results)
Minimalist approach trending: “only 6 plugins you need” resonates more than plugin maximalism


5. Diagrams: Mermaid & Excalidraw



















#TitleChannelViewsURL1Claude Code Creates Mermaid & Excalidraw Architecture DiagramsLEsteveTech1.7Kwatch
Takeaways: Very few recent dedicated videos on this topic. The one result shows Claude Code generating Mermaid and Excalidraw diagrams automatically — reinforcing the AI+Obsidian trend. Excalidraw plugin remains the primary visual diagramming tool in Obsidian. Mermaid is natively supported in Obsidian (no plugin needed). For architecture diagrams, Claude Code can generate both formats directly from code analysis.

6. Russian Content: Obsidian Second Brain















































#TitleChannelViewsURL1Может Obsidian наладит жизнь? (Готовая сборка)Agony45Kwatch2Почему твой Второй Мозг не работает. Главная ошибкаELisi-um15Kwatch3Второй МОЗГ На Obsidian И Gemini CLIИИшенка15Kwatch4Как больше запоминать — система связей в ObsidianElton Labs12Kwatch5Claude Code + Obsidian — Мой ИИ-рабочий стек 2026Продуктивный Совет5.9Kwatch
Takeaways:

Agony (45K) — provides a ready-made Obsidian build (plugins, theme, dashboard, vault) via Google Docs link
ELisi-um — critical perspective: “your Second Brain doesn’t work” because of Zettelkasten over-engineering, beautiful graphs but no real thinking improvement
Gemini CLI + Obsidian — Russian AI community is exploring Gemini as an Obsidian agent (ИИшенка channel, Pro community on Telegram)
Elton Labs — focuses on memory/linking system, practical approach to Obsidian connections
Claude Code + Obsidian trend is visible in Russian content too (Продуктивный Совет, Mar 11)


Key Themes & Recommendations
Top Trends

AI Agent + Obsidian is the dominant 2026 narrative — Claude Code integration is the most-discussed topic
Minimalist plugin approach — community shifting from “install everything” to curated 5-6 essential plugins
Bases (core plugin) replacing Dataview for many use cases
Notebook Navigator as a rising star plugin
NotebookLM as research companion — feeding Obsidian content into NotebookLM for audio/summaries

Recommended Plugins (from research)

Templater (template automation)
Dataview / Bases (queries and databases)
Excalidraw (visual diagrams)
Notebook Navigator (unified workflow)
Calendar (daily notes navigation)
Digital Garden (free publishing alternative)

Recommended Workflows

PARA structure (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive) — still the most recommended organizational method
Daily notes + Templater for capture
Linking Your Thinking (LYT) framework by Nick Milo for knowledge organization
Claude Code agent reading/writing vault files for task automation
Quartz 4 for free static site publishing (alternative to Obsidian Publish)

Channels to Follow

Linking Your Thinking (Nick Milo) — 317K subs, gold standard for Obsidian education
Karlos Obsidian Tutorials — 6.8K subs, deep dives and CEO vault analysis
Focus Cafe — 1.4K subs, excellent plugin reviews
Chase AI — 63K subs, Obsidian + AI integration content
ИИшенка — 17K subs, Russian AI + Obsidian automation
